info.name: DMoney API Testing - Assignment 2
info.description: End-to-end flow: Admin creates 2 Customers, 1 Agent and 1 Merchant -> Admin activates them -> SYSTEM funds the Agent -> Agent deposits to Customer 1 (commission) -> Customer 1 sends money to Customer 2 (fee) -> Customer 2 cashes out via the Agent (fee) -> Customer 1 pays the Merchant (fee). 30 test cases (TC-001..TC-030), positive and negative, with assertions. See ../Testcase.md for the test design and ../APiDocumentation.md for the endpoint reference.
